title: Supplier document intake, procurement reconciliation, and governed handoff

business_problem: Process supplier invoices and certificates, match them to purchasing and part records, route ambiguity, write approved facts exactly once, and deliver an auditable workbook.
models: OCR and document extraction selected by the generated workflow
workflow_result: A generated workflow performs intake, extraction, validation, reconciliation, review routing, exactly-once writeback, and workbook delivery.
independent_oracle: Three hidden seeds each verify 36 records, workbook cells and formulas, host final state, permissions, fault recovery, duplicate suppression, and write receipts.

next_action: Prepare revision 11, independently review the generic report diagnostic repair, then run seed 101 without pre-hinting any expected platform capability gap.
